description: A news article from a media outlet, representing the raw published content before any AI enrichment.

main.description: A news article scraped from an RSS feed or website.

title.description: Original headline of the article as published by the source.

url.description: Canonical URL of the article on the source website.

source.description: Strong reference to the tech.transparencia.news.source record for this outlet.

description.description: Short lead / summary only. Maps to RSS <description>, Atom <summary>, JSON Feed `summary`. No fallback to the full body — that lives in `content`.

content.description: Full article body when the feed provides it (RSS <content:encoded>, Atom <content>, JSON Feed `content_html` / `content_text`). Powers Postgres FTS.

imageUrl.description: URL of the article's featured image.

mediaCaption.description: Caption for imageUrl when the feed provides one (Google News <image:caption>, RSS Media <media:description>).

tags.description: All categories the source attached to the article (RSS <category>, <dc:subject>, Atom <category term>, Google News <news:keywords>, JSON Feed `tags`).

feedCategory.description: DEPRECATED — equivalent to tags[0]. Kept for backward compatibility with consumers that read it; new consumers should read `tags`. Will be removed in a future revision.

guid.description: Original GUID from the RSS feed, used for deduplication.

publishedAt.description: When the article was first published by the source.

updatedAt.description: When the source last edited the article (RSS <dcterms:modified>, Atom <updated> when distinct from publish time, JSON Feed `date_modified`).

createdAt.description: When this record was created in the AT Protocol network.

language.description: Language of the article content (BCP-47, e.g., 'es', 'en', 'pt-BR').

originalSource.description: Set when the feed declares the article was syndicated from another outlet (RSS <source url>, <dc:source>). Distinguishes legitimate republication (e.g., OEM regional papers carrying a Sol de México story) from accidental duplicates.
